candidates.change_summary: Replace withdrawAll body to transfer zero instead of calling withdraw with full balance, so withdrawAll no longer empties contract balance.
Replace withdrawAll body to call withdraw with msg.sender instead of contract balance, causing different transferred amount (likely zero) and different observable post-state.
Replace onlyOwner modifier's require to allow any caller (remove ownership check), so withdrawAll can be called by anyone and changes observable behavior after external calls.
Replace transfer to send so withdraw forwards only 2300 gas and returns a boolean instead of reverting on failure.
Use call with empty data and full gas to send value (no automatic revert on failure) and revert manually on failure — changes gas semantics and reentrancy surface.
Make onlyOwner modifier check inverted (require caller is NOT owner), allowing withdraw to be executed by non-owner instead of owner.
Remove onlyOwner guard from withdraw so anyone can call withdraw, changing who can extract funds.
Replace the low-level call with a direct transfer, which forwards 2300 gas and reverts on failure, changing reentrancy/gas behavior and thus observable depositsCount after sendMoney.

Replace the low-level call with a call that ignores the returned success flag (no revert on failure), so failed calls do not revert and state changes in the caller persist, altering observable behavior.

Change the call to be staticcall, which disallows state-modifying fallback on the target and can change behavior (e.g., prevent target from sending Ether back), affecting observable state like depositsCount.
Remove the require check so onlyOwner no longer restricts access, allowing non-owner callers to call sendMoney and thus change observable behavior.
